rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose modifier for objects that slide in and out, such as a telescopic baton.

example.english: This telescopic baton folds away into a bag, which is very convenient.
example.traditional: 呢枝伸縮式警棍收埋喺袋入面，好方便。

rows.note: Use this before an action to say it is carried out with a telescope, rather than merely visible through one.

example.english: We used a telescope for telescopic observation of the nebula.
example.traditional: 我哋用望遠鏡觀察星雲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jung6 mong6 jyun5 geng3 gun1 caat3 sing1 wan4

rows.jyutping: jiu3 jung6 mong6 jyun5 geng3 sin1 V
rows.note: Use this when something cannot be seen unless a telescope is used.

example.english: That star is telescopic and can only be seen with a telescope.
example.traditional: 嗰粒星要用望遠鏡先睇到。
example.jyutping: go2 nap1 sing1 jiu3 jung6 mong6 jyun5 geng3 sin1 tai2 dou2
